tools.name: get_review
tools.description: Fetch a Cobalt Capture review by its share link or slug. Returns the reviewer's notes as text AND each annotated screenshot as an image, so you can see exactly what was marked and what to change.

tools.name: create_review
tools.description: Start a new Cobalt Capture review and get a handle for filling it in. Use this to compile the findings of any site study — a usability pass, a pricing teardown, a positioning audit, a QA run — into one shareable, durable report with real screenshots. Works from any client, chat assistants included:

tools.name: add_screenshot
tools.description: Append a screenshot (with an optional note) to a review created by create_review. tools.name: add_note
tools.description: Append a free-standing text note (not tied to a screenshot) to a review created by create_review. Use for context, steps taken, or a summary of findings between screenshots.

tools.name: update_review
tools.description: Update a review's summary and/or title after the fact. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_review, create_review, get_playbook, create_inbox, check_inbox · Private data: add_screenshot, create_inbox · Public sink: get_review, create_review, add_screenshot, get_playbook, create_inbox, check_inbox, email_review · Destructive: create_review, update_review, get_playbook, check_inbox, email_review.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_review, create_review, get_playbook, create_inbox, check_inbox · Private data: add_screenshot, create_inbox · Public sink: get_review, create_review, add_screenshot, get_playbook, create_inbox, check_inbox, email_review · Destructive: create_review, update_review, get_playbook, check_inbox, email_review

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
